Questions & answers

Before you hire me.

How do I start a project?

Send me a WhatsApp message with what you need, your preferred deadline and any reference materials. We'll discuss the details before I start.

What type of designs do you create?

Flyers, posters, product adverts, social media graphics, logos, brand identity work and other custom graphic design projects.

Can I request changes?

Yes. We can discuss revisions as part of the project before final delivery.

How do I receive the final design?

Final files can be delivered digitally in the formats needed for social media, print or other use.
